# Accessibility

Flare UI treats keyboard, focus, screen readers, large text, reduced motion, high contrast, and touch targets as release contracts.

## State semantics

MessageStatus, unread, error, selected, mention, and presence states cannot rely on color alone. Visible state and accessible names update together.

## Platforms

Vue uses ARIA; Flutter uses Semantics and Focus; Compose uses semantics; SwiftUI uses accessibility traits and Dynamic Type.

## Testing

Automated gates cover structure and baselines. VoiceOver, TalkBack, hardware keyboards, and physical large-text runs follow the [device matrix](/en/accessibility/).
